label: Hero Scene
description: Premium floating product shot with dramatic studio lighting

subject.view: three-quarter hero angle, device tilted about 30 degrees

spec.prompt_template: Ultra-premium studio product photograph of a single {product_name}, floating in dark space. VIEW: {view}. Preserve the EXACT object shown in the reference images — do not restyle, recolour, or change the geometry. Dramatic dark studio look: near-black background #0a0a0b, a soft deep-blue radial glow behind the product, a crisp electric-blue rim light tracing the top edge, a subtle soft reflection beneath. The product is floating — no surface, no desk, no props. Razor-sharp focus edge to edge, hero product shot, generous even margins.
